stories.title: Define Weighting Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define data model for user-adjustable weights across quality measures, including defaults, bounds, normalization rules (sum=1), and persistence format for reuse across sessions; include versioning for future measure changes.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing weighting schema; persistence to be implemented using Mongo utilities (Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py)

stories.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Logic
stories.description: Extend provider and clinical trial scoring engines to apply user-defined weights, enforce normalization (sum=1), handle missing measures deterministically, and ensure consistent recomputation across both domains.
stories.evidence: GAP: Existing scoring engines (evaluate_care_facade.py, clinical_trials_service.py) do not support dynamic weighting

stories.title: Expose Weight Adjustment API and UI Controls
stories.description: Create backend endpoints and frontend controls (e.g., sliders) to allow users to adjust weights, persist preferences, and trigger score recalculation in real time with immediate UI feedback.

stories.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate weighting inputs into evaluate_care_facade, ensuring request contract supports optional weights, applies defaults when absent, and routes weights consistently to both provider and clinical trial scoring paths.

stories.title: Weighting Logic Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for weighting calculations (normalization, edge cases) and integration tests validating end-to-end score changes when weights are adjusted across provider and clinical trial flows.
